description: Get a presigned URL to upload your own image, video or audio file. PUT the file bytes to uploadUrl with the returned headers (Content-Type must match and the body must be exactly `size` bytes), then call quiz_video_complete_media_upload. Files go to Quiz.Video storage; quizzes can only use uploaded files, never outside URLs. Limits: images 15 MB, videos 250 MB and 5 minutes, audio 50 MB. Use purpose "music" to add a background track, which returns a musicId to set as backgroundMusicId.
name: quiz_video_create_media_upload
title: Start a media upload
